messages:
anya: FYI ran a quick inventory and spotted ~5 old DB snapshot objects under gs://redwood-archives/snapshots/2019-2020 with no kmsKeyName or our x-encrypt-meta header.

ben: Can you paste one path and the `gsutil ls -L` snippet?

anya: example: snapshots/2019-11/db-prod-20191103.tar.gz. `gsutil ls -L` shows only Content-Type/CRC32C, no encryption fields.

meera: timeline matches pre-CMEK rollout. Likely uploaded by legacy backup agent. Do we have uploader principal in the insert logs?

anya: quick log query I ran: `protoPayload.methodName="storage.objects.insert" protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:"backup-agent-legacy@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" timestamp>="2019-01-01" AND timestamp<"2021-01-01"` -> matches.

encops-bot: ALERT: missing_encryption_meta detected (5 objects). Recommend re-encrypt or escrow.

ben: Immediate plan: 1) block further uploads from legacy SA (remove write binding), 2) test rewrite to CMEK on 2 files, 3) scan access logs for any GETs.

meera: I ran access logs -> no public GETs, only internal SAs and `vendor-uploader@partner.com`.

anya: test rewrite `gsutil rewrite -k projects/PROJ/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/ck gs://redwood-archives/snapshots/2019-11/db-prod-20191103.tar.gz` succeeded locally, metadata shows `kmsKeyName`.

ben: Good. Open ENCRYPT-OPS ticket, assign P2, include sample keys and CL logging query. Also create escrow manifest for audit (object path + original upload event id).

meera: I'll remove legacy SA perms in infra PR and add pre-merge check requiring `encryption_review=true`.

sre-oncall: If any external reads are found escalate to #incidents. Otherwise label this compliance gap and prepare customer-safe statement draft.

anya: Adding nightly scanner to flag objects missing x-encrypt-meta. Will post results to private dashboard.

encops-bot: REMINDER: store escrow manifests in a restricted bucket protected with CMEK and limited ACLs.
